verdict.rationale: Intuit's developer docs list a dedicated Webhooks page for the QuickBooks Workforce (payroll) API, so integrators can be notified when a connected company runs payroll or adds or updates an employee. Webhooks also appear among the core development building blocks. The in-app alerts and admin texts are user notifications, not programmatic callbacks, so they were not credited. Missing for 10: registration/subscription mechanics, payload and signature/verification details, the full event catalog (the evidence is only truncated llms.txt index summaries), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
